method: Direct view_image inspection of four local before/after comparison boards on black and white backgrounds and native mapped frames 014 and 025. Independently compared all 49 mapped RGBA frames against V6 using Pillow/NumPy.

evidence.observation: The small pale pocket near the hand/headset gap is reduced without observable damage to the palm silhouette, thumb, cuff or adjacent headset line. Native character proportions and hand pose are preserved.
The pale dot below the headset is removed on the black-background comparison. The surrounding dark hair/headset and sleeve border remain intact; no new visible hole appears in skin or clothing.

limitations: This is a delta review inheriting V6's static-art acceptance and limitations, not a new full continuous-playback review.
Only the 49 mapped frame RGBA files were pixel-compared; atlas packing, browser loading, timing and runtime transition behavior remain the root reviewer's responsibility.
Minor pre-existing edge softness and stylistic differences noted in V6 remain; this record does not claim pixel-perfect artwork.
No deployment was performed or authorized by this review record.
